definitions.R9: band = 1/sqrt(scored), scored = non-error graded lines across all reps; n = distinct cases incl. errors; scored = 0 raises ValueError.

definitions.kappa: kappa = (po - pe) / (1 - pe): po = observed agreement, pe = agreement expected by chance from each rater's share of true; if pe == 1 it is 1.0 when po == 1 else 0.0.
